# Testing the /check endpoint with cURL

Here are some cURL commands you can use to test the POST /check endpoint:

## Start the server
```bash
node app.js
```

## Test 1: Simple amount comparison (should return true)
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/check \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"rule": "ctx.amount > 100", "context": {"amount": 150}}'
```

## Test 2: String comparison (should return true)
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/check \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"rule": "ctx.user.name === \"Alice\"", "context": {"user": {"name": "Alice"}}}'
```

## Test 3: Access request object (should return true)
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/check \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"rule": "req.method === \"POST\""}'
```

## Test 4: Complex expression (multiply two context values)
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/check \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"rule": "ctx.price * ctx.quantity > 50", "context": {"price": 10, "quantity": 6}}'
```

## Test 5: Error case - missing rule
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/check \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

## Test 6: Error case - invalid JavaScript
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/check \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"rule": "this is not valid javascript"}'
```
